intro: Can you find every cat hiding in this romantic world?
description:
Prepare for a delightful mission in a romantic landscape. Every corner hides a fluffy surprise just waiting to be petted!

Enter a charming black-and-white world filled with adorable cats, romance, and specially themed locations. In 100 Romantic Hidden Cats, you embark on a journey where your task is to bring this wonderful world to life by finding all the hidden furry friends. Each location is designed in the style of a detailed coloring book, but within this simplicity lies a true challenge! Explore every corner, look closely, and discover cats hiding in unexpected places.

Game Features:
• Unique visual style: each level looks like a coloring book.
• Unique locations to explore.
• 100 adorable cats, masterfully hidden on each map.
• Real meow sounds!
• Color magic: tap a cat and it instantly turns vibrant.
• Cozy gameplay experience: search, explore, and make the world a little brighter!

Explore. Search. Discover. Bring the world to life, one cat at a time!
